description: This file contains serialization codecs for primitive floating-point types (float, double, decimal, half) used in the Orleans.Serialization library. It defines classes that implement serialization and deserialization logic for these types, including support for different wire formats and platform-specific conversions.

classes.name: FloatCodec
classes.description: Serializer for the float type, handling encoding and decoding of 32-bit floating point values.

classes.name: DoubleCodec
classes.description: Serializer for the double type, handling encoding and decoding of 64-bit floating point values.

classes.name: DecimalCodec
classes.description: Serializer for the decimal type, supporting length-prefixed encoding and raw binary representation.

classes.name: HalfCodec
classes.description: Serializer for the Half (16-bit floating point) type, supported only in .NET 6 or greater.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes the given float/double/decimal/half value to the buffer with optional type info.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a float/double/decimal/half value from the buffer based on the wire type.

methods.name: ReadFloatRaw
methods.description: Reads raw float bits from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadDoubleRaw
methods.description: Reads raw double bits from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadDecimalRaw
methods.description: Reads raw decimal value from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadHalfRaw
methods.description: Reads raw half (16-bit float) value from the buffer.
